title: Beyond the Magnificent Seven: The Next Wave of AI Investment
description: The first phase of the artificial intelligence (AI) investment story belonged to a handful of remarkable companies. Apple, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Nvidia, Meta and Tesla, the so-called Magnificent Seven, sit at the centre of the most important technology shift in a generation, and the market has rewarded them for it. They now account for roughly a third of the S&P 500, and in 2025 they produced about 42% of the index's total return1. Buy a plain US index fund today and nearly 40 cents of every dollar goes into just 10 companies.
